name: krab
description: krab (the Rust Kapitan): inventory support: live diagnostics, hover with resolved values and provenance, go to definition, completion

krab.path.description: Path to the krab binary (must support `krab lsp`). Use the same binary as your shell: the daemon it starts serves both.

krab.python.description: Python interpreter for the inventory's Python resolvers (passed to the language server as KRAB_PYTHON). The editor's environment rarely has the right one on PATH.

krab.trace.server.description: Trace LSP traffic in the krab output channel.
